ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and inner lobe regions, with 40% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed across the lateral wing surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. White pigmentation appears as broad, irregular mottling on the lateral lobes, punctuated by fine black linear streaks and small, discrete white circular spots in dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; interior angle measured at approximately 48 degrees with a moderate vertical depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the medial sections of the trailing edge with amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels. Multiple jagged irregularities are present along the entire boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, flattening toward the mid-lobe, and terminating in a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular clusters (acorn barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple circular ring-shaped scars with dark boundaries and light centers are visible on the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear disruptions; prominent vertical white scratch on the lower right lobe and multiple dark, rake-like scratches across the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle colonization on lobe tips; visible circular scars likely from parasitic attachment; a distinct notch/irregularity on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 2/3 out from the center.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'splash' pattern mottling on the lateral edges of both lobes.
